newsitem.title: USA: Arrhythmia Research signs acquisition letter.
newsitem.headline: Arrhythmia Research signs acquisition letter.

text.p: Arrhythmia Research Technology Inc said on Tuesday it had signed a letter of intent to acquire J-Pac Corp and the plastics division of Janco Inc, both privately held comapanies, for a purchase price of about $6.0 million.

The purchase price is subject to future earnings targets, and will include cash and stock, the company said in a statement. The transaction itself is subject to completion of due diligence and obtaining satisfactory financing, it added.

It said it estimates that on a pro forma basis Janco would contribute annualized sales after the acquisition of approximately $8.0 million and earnings per share should increase. The company added that current plans include obtaining both senior secured bank debt and unsecured subordinated debt financing.
The company sells equipment used in the cardiovascular and electrophysiology fields for diagnosing and treating patients with irregular heartbeats.

J-Pac Corp is a contract manufacturer of plastic products, including medical health care products, packaging and clean room packaging services, with operations in Dover, N.H., Hampshire, near Arrhythmia's Micron Products subsidiary.
